premises.text: Market leaders target video ads with user data and reach, producing irrelevant ads that users skip
premises.evidence_span: all the market leader, like Google, Facebook, they all base targeting on user data and reach

premises.text: Content recognition layered on user data improves targeting, including where cookie targeting is disabled on mobile
premises.evidence_span: Relevancy data bring the power of the content on top of the user data. And in the mobile advertising, where cookie-based targeting is disabled, a new standard on targeting solution

premises.text: Engine detects faces, objects, logos, music, demographics, and emotion and times ad placement to the matching second
premises.evidence_span: We know exactly the second that the metadata appears, and we know the frequency

premises.text: Customers are digital TVs/operators, online video platforms, media companies, and brands
premises.evidence_span: Our customers are the digital TVs and operators like Fox, RTL, the online platform like YouTube, Dailymotion, and the media companies and the brands like GroupM

premises.text: Monetization is selling recognition data plus campaign management
premises.evidence_span: We earn money from selling the data. In addition, we offer a campaign management

value.text: Advertisers control where ads land so users enjoy related ads with video content
value.evidence_span: they're able to control their ads. They're able to search where they want their ads will land

secondary_value.text: Content providers stop losing money to skipped ads; brands improve ROI
secondary_value.evidence_span: The content provider losing money because every click skip this ad

causal_links.evidence_span: match on the right second the relevant advertising

notes: Campaign lift stats excluded as traction. Patent folded into engine. Mission statement and AOL quote treated as framing/vision. Customer list kept as GTM channel condition bundled with monetization.
